dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: SHARDFALL CAPTAINS' CHAMBER

dialogueInline.speaker: PIKE
dialogueInline.text: Two pressure seams on my berth failed. We gave up plates to Auric when you argued their shelter needed them more. My crew slept in suits for two nights.

dialogueInline.speaker: TESS
dialogueInline.text: I know.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIKE
dialogueInline.text: I didn't come all the way here to hear you say you know.

dialogueInline.speaker: TESS
dialogueInline.text: Then you've traveled a long way for an argument you can conduct perfectly well at your own dock.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIKE
dialogueInline.text: I am challenging your standing before witnesses.

dialogueInline.speaker: ABBY
dialogueInline.text: You can argue about the plates without a duel.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIKE
dialogueInline.text: She made an emergency decision for crews she didn't command. Everyone seems happy with that now because the Auric roof stayed up.

dialogueInline.speaker: TESS
dialogueInline.text: Not everyone. You're here.

panelPlan: SHARDFALL CAPTAINS' CHAMBER. Oren Pike arrives with repair invoices, not an empty declaration of honor. Tess Banks has been summoned. Abby attends but does not.
Pike invokes the formal challenge. The witnesses accept it. His grievance has substance, even if his taste for public vindication makes it worse.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: VEIL MARKET RATION HALL

dialogueInline.speaker: JEX
dialogueInline.text: I'd love to know who thought making a spectacle of a captain's bruises would improve the ration count.

dialogueInline.speaker: NAOMI
dialogueInline.text: Six pallets were diverted. Who signed them out?

dialogueInline.speaker: JEX
dialogueInline.text: I can trace the signatures. It will take longer than explaining to this crowd why a duel isn't dinner.

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: Some captains want Fleet to make a move while they're watching Shardfall.

dialogueInline.speaker: VENN
dialogueInline.text: Their duel isn't a transit closure.

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: Good. The unarmed repair tug needs a route before the third watch. I'd rather discuss that than fencing techniques.

dialogueInline.speaker: VENN
dialogueInline.text: So would I. Keep the lane clear. If Pike wants Fleet involved, he can send us a request that has something to do with Fleet.

panelPlan: VEIL MARKET RATION HALL. Naomi and Jex find six diverted pallets while crowds watch news of Pike's challenge on a secondary screen.
On Thunderbreak, Deka shows Venn the reports.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: SHARDFALL — DUEL CHAMBER

dialogueInline.speaker: PIKE
dialogueInline.text: What's that supposed to prove?

dialogueInline.speaker: TESS
dialogueInline.text: From Gravefire's radiator. It's why we're late for everything and why I have to be careful turning left. You told me I made other people pay for the shelter decision. I thought you might appreciate seeing what it cost my crew.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIKE
dialogueInline.text: Don't show me a scrap of metal and call it equality. My people slept in leaking suits.

dialogueInline.speaker: TESS
dialogueInline.text: And the people under that roof could breathe. Both things are true. I won't apologize for keeping the roof up. I will apologize for deciding what you could spare without asking.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIKE
dialogueInline.text: If I'd said no?

panelPlan: The duel chamber is not yet crowded. Tess takes a small broken fitting from her pocket and sets it beside the challenge record. Pike notices.
directionInline: Use released Rex Fleet references for appearance, faction and ship design. Preserve exact dialogue, action and speaker order.

dialogueInline.speaker: TESS
dialogueInline.text: I might have taken the plates anyway. I wasn't going to let the roof collapse while we negotiated a price.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIKE
dialogueInline.text: Then you've learned nothing.

dialogueInline.speaker: TESS
dialogueInline.text: I've learned that you could be right about my decision and still be wrong to challenge me like this.

panelPlan: Pike picks up his weapon. The witnesses enter. Neither wants to be the first to look away.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: SHARDFALL / VEIL MARKET

dialogueInline.speaker: WORKER
dialogueInline.text: That's your ship crew. The freighters need them at the landing.

dialogueInline.speaker: NAOMI
dialogueInline.text: The freighters can wait for the living to get to the food. Open the second door.

dialogueInline.speaker: WORKER
dialogueInline.text: The lock's jammed.

dialogueInline.speaker: NAOMI
dialogueInline.text: Of course it is. If one thing worked the first time we tried it, I'd begin to distrust the whole station.

panelPlan: A crush forms at one Veil Market ration door. Naomi diverts half her unloading crew to open a second passage without waiting for the duel result or a political.
They force the passage and direct the crowd through in smaller groups. The diversion means unloading slows. Naomi accepts that cost rather than inventing more.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: SHARDFALL DUEL FLOOR

dialogueInline.speaker: PIKE
dialogueInline.text: You should have listened when I asked you to account for the pressure plates.

dialogueInline.speaker: TESS
dialogueInline.text: I'm listening now. It's noisy in here.

dialogueInline.speaker: WITNESS
dialogueInline.text: Yield, Captain Pike.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIKE
dialogueInline.text: You can finish it.

dialogueInline.speaker: TESS
dialogueInline.text: You're going to have to be considerably more annoying before I kill you.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIKE
dialogueInline.text: That would take effort.

dialogueInline.speaker: TESS
dialogueInline.text: I know. You've already spent so much.

panelPlan: SHARDFALL DUEL FLOOR. Pike moves like a veteran, not a publicity fool. Tess respects that a fraction too late; he cuts her left forearm. Blood darkens her cuff.
Pike breathes hard. The room wants one of them to make a speech. Tess releases him.
The yield is witnessed. Tess wins and is injured. Pike survives with a real grievance, not an erased one.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: SHARDFALL — CAPTAINS / VEIL MARKET

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTAIN
dialogueInline.text: Our crews will have nowhere to repair if you do this.

dialogueInline.speaker: RAID MASK
dialogueInline.text: You have chosen your association. The berth was held under Confederacy service.

dialogueInline.speaker: ABBY
dialogueInline.text: They'll need somewhere to dock.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTAIN
dialogueInline.text: I wasn't asking you to speak for me.

dialogueInline.speaker: ABBY
dialogueInline.text: I know. I was asking what you need.

dialogueInline.speaker: VENN
dialogueInline.text: No. They didn't break from Raid so we could take their ships on a paperwork technicality. Offer them safe transit if they request it.

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: It's always easier to get a captain to agree with you when you've got a dock you can withhold.

dialogueInline.speaker: VENN
dialogueInline.text: Then let's not become the people who discover that.

panelPlan: The hungry market does not celebrate the duel. At Shardfall, two captains reject Raid's muster after witnessing the result. Raid freezes their berths.
On Thunderbreak, an officer proposes bringing the two captains under Fleet control in return for protection.
The two captains' berth loss remains real. Abby begins finding space that neither she nor Fleet can conjure out of nothing.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: TAL CORVUS, THE NEXT DAY

dialogueInline.speaker: CHILD
dialogueInline.text: It was open yesterday.

dialogueInline.speaker: TESS
dialogueInline.text: So was my arm.

dialogueInline.speaker: TESS
dialogueInline.text: I'm joking. Badly. Who told you to use this door?

dialogueInline.speaker: CHILD
dialogueInline.text: Everybody.

dialogueInline.speaker: TESS
dialogueInline.text: Then we'd better tell everybody there's a better one. Come on. You can point it out to me while I try not to bang this thing against a railing.

panelPlan: TAL CORVUS, THE NEXT DAY. Gravefire brings Tess home with her left forearm bandaged. A child asks why a useful route arrow points to a closed doorway. Tess.
The child looks distressed. Tess smiles faintly.
They walk toward an actual open passage. Tess's victory has not made the routes safer; people still have to do the work.
